Proof in the paper: The XRD pattern of the fcc-Ni/C (Fig. 1a) shows diffraction peaks assigned to the fcc phase of Ni (PDF card no. 04-0850).
In the case of hcp-Ni/C, all the identified peaks can be indexed to the hcp phase of Ni (PDF card no. 45-1027).
The HRTEM image of hcp-CuNi/C (Fig. 2k) displays well-resolved lattice fringes with interplanar spacing of 0.187 nm indexed to the (0002) planes of the hcp phase of CuNi.
